# Story 01 — Organization Structure: Branches, Departments, Teams and User Placement (Story: 448)

## Prerequisites

- None. This is the **first** story in the backlog. Every later feature (routing, SLA, reporting scope, permissions) depends on this organisational spine, as called out in the intake description.
- Coordinate with owners of the `Security` domain (BE-03 permissions, BE-08 audit) — this story provisions the initial `AuditLogger` contract stub and the first Policy against permission keys. Keep the shape consistent with the conventions digest so BE-03/BE-08 can slot in.

---

## Story Goal

Model the single company as **Branches → Departments → Teams**, and place staff users inside that structure through the API. Deliver:

1. CRUD for **Branch**, **Department**, **Team** with bilingual names, activate/deactivate, rename.
2. Structural constraints: a **Department** belongs to exactly one **Branch**; a **Team** belongs to exactly one **Department**.
3. User placement: a user can belong to **many departments** and **many branches**, with exactly **one primary branch**.
4. Guard: **deactivating a Department is blocked (or requires reassignment)** while open tickets still reference it. Since the Ticketing domain is not built yet, expose the guard as a pluggable **`DepartmentUsageChecker`** contract that returns `0` today and will be wired to open tickets by the Ticketing story.
5. Every write goes through **`App\Domains\Security\Services\AuditLogger::record`** with actor, `before`, `after`.
6. All admin-visible names stored and returned as `{ ar, en }` JSON objects — never a pre-picked string.

Explicitly **out of scope**: tenant provisioning, subscriptions, cross-organisation isolation, role/permission seeding beyond the keys this story needs, ticket routing rules, UI/Frontend. The single-organisation rule from `docs/contracts/conventions-digest.md:4` still holds — **do not** introduce `tenant_id`.

## Product rules (from story)

Current behaviour: no organisation model exists; `users` has no branch/department linkage; there is no audit trail.

New behaviour after this story:
- **Branch, Department, Team** are first-class entities with bilingual names, `is_active` flag, timestamps, UUID PKs.
- A **Department** is `branch_id`-scoped (non-null FK, `restrict on delete`).
- A **Team** is `department_id`-scoped (non-null FK, `restrict on delete`).
- **Users ↔ Branches** is many-to-many with a `is_primary` flag; exactly one primary per user is enforced at DB (partial unique index where supported) **and** in the Action layer.
- **Users ↔ Departments** is many-to-many, no primary flag.
- **Deactivating a Department**: the endpoint runs `DepartmentUsageChecker::openTicketCount($departmentId)`. If `> 0`, return HTTP 409 with error code `department.has_open_tickets` and the count in `error.meta.open_tickets`. If `== 0`, mark inactive, write audit entry, return the updated resource. A `reassign_to_department_id` request param, when present, is accepted but stored as a note in the audit `after` payload — actual bulk reassignment of tickets is deferred to Ticketing (leave a TODO in the Action).
- Every write (create/rename/activate/deactivate/attach/detach/set-primary) emits **one** `AuditLogger::record` call inside the same DB transaction as the write.
- All list endpoints return the standard envelope from `conventions-digest.md:14-17`.

### 2 — Migrations

All migrations use `Illuminate\Support\Str::uuid()` for PKs and `char(36)` FKs (per conventions-digest `:5`; if the team prefers `binary(16)`, follow `api-contract.md` — grep first).

**Create file: `database/migrations/2026_08_26_010000_add_uuid_to_users.php`**

- Add `uuid` column (`char(36)`, unique, not-null, backfilled with `Str::uuid()` for existing rows).
- Do **not** drop `id` bigint yet — Sanctum's `personal_access_tokens.tokenable_id` is bigint. Follow-up story will flip PKs. Document this compromise in the migration docblock.

**Create file: `database/migrations/2026_08_26_010100_create_branches_table.php`**

```php
Schema::create('branches', function (Blueprint $t) {
    $t->char('id', 36)->primary();
    $t->json('name');                 // {ar, en}
    $t->string('code')->unique();     // short slug for URLs, ascii
    $t->string('timezone', 64);       // IANA, e.g. Africa/Cairo
    $t->boolean('is_24_7')->default(false);
    $t->boolean('is_active')->default(true);
    $t->timestamps();
    $t->softDeletes();
});
```

**Create file: `database/migrations/2026_08_26_010200_create_departments_table.php`**

```php
Schema::create('departments', function (Blueprint $t) {
    $t->char('id', 36)->primary();
    $t->char('branch_id', 36);
    $t->json('name');
    $t->string('code');
    $t->boolean('is_active')->default(true);
    $t->timestamps();
    $t->softDeletes();
    $t->foreign('branch_id')->references('id')->on('branches')->restrictOnDelete();
    $t->unique(['branch_id', 'code']);
});
```

**Create file: `database/migrations/2026_08_26_010300_create_teams_table.php`**

Same shape, FK to `departments`, unique `(department_id, code)`.

**Create file: `database/migrations/2026_08_26_010400_create_user_branch_table.php`**

```php
Schema::create('user_branch', function (Blueprint $t) {
    $t->char('user_uuid', 36);
    $t->char('branch_id', 36);
    $t->boolean('is_primary')->default(false);
    $t->timestamps();
    $t->primary(['user_uuid', 'branch_id']);
    $t->foreign('user_uuid')->references('uuid')->on('users')->cascadeOnDelete();
    $t->foreign('branch_id')->references('id')->on('branches')->restrictOnDelete();
});
// Partial unique on (user_uuid) where is_primary = true — MySQL 8+ supports functional index; SQLite skips.
```

**Create file: `database/migrations/2026_08_26_010500_create_user_department_table.php`**

Composite PK `(user_uuid, department_id)`, FKs, timestamps.

**Create file: `database/migrations/2026_08_26_010600_create_audit_logs_table.php`**

```php
Schema::create('audit_logs', function (Blueprint $t) {
    $t->char('id', 36)->primary();
    $t->char('actor_uuid', 36)->nullable();
    $t->string('action', 128);        // e.g. organisation.branch.created
    $t->string('target_type', 64);    // Branch|Department|Team|UserBranch|UserDepartment
    $t->char('target_id', 36);
    $t->json('before')->nullable();
    $t->json('after')->nullable();
    $t->timestamp('recorded_at')->useCurrent();
    $t->index(['target_type', 'target_id']);
    $t->index(['actor_uuid']);
    // NO down updates/deletes — table is append-only per conventions-digest:25
});
```

### 4 — Actions (one class per verb)

Each Action:
- Runs inside `DB::transaction(...)`.
- Loads `before` snapshot (`$model->toArray()` or `null` for create).
- Applies change.
- Calls `AuditLogger::record(auth()->user(), $action, $model->refresh(), $before, $model->toArray())`.
- Returns the model.

Special cases:

- **`SetPrimaryBranchForUser`**: within the transaction, set `is_primary = false` on all pivot rows for that user, then set `true` on the target. Verify the target pivot row exists first; otherwise throw a domain exception mapped to HTTP 422.
- **`DeactivateDepartment`**: call `app(DepartmentUsageChecker::class)->openTicketCount($id)`. If `> 0`, throw `DepartmentInUseException` mapped by the exception handler to `409 department.has_open_tickets` with `meta.open_tickets` set. Accept optional `reassign_to_department_id` and include it in the audit `after` under `reassign_intent` — TODO comment linking to the Ticketing story.
- **`Deactivate*`**: sets `is_active = false`. Does **not** soft-delete. Soft delete is only via a separate `Delete*` action, out of scope here.

### 6 — FormRequests

- Every `name` field validated as `array:ar,en`, each `required|string|max:255`.
- `code` `required|string|regex:/^[a-z0-9-]{2,32}$/`.
- `timezone` `required|timezone` (Laravel rule).
- `branch_id`, `department_id` must exist and be active (except on the deactivate endpoint itself).
- Authorisation delegated to Policies — do **not** short-circuit in the FormRequest.

### 7 — Resources (API shape)

Every Resource returns bilingual names as objects, not strings, per `conventions-digest.md:7`.

```php
// BranchResource
return [
    'id' => $this->id,
    'name' => $this->name,            // { ar, en }
    'code' => $this->code,
    'timezone' => $this->timezone,
    'is_24_7' => (bool) $this->is_24_7,
    'is_active' => (bool) $this->is_active,
    'created_at' => $this->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
    'updated_at' => $this->updated_at?->toIso8601String(),
];
```

Envelope wrapping is handled by the standard `data`/`meta`/`links` — do not double wrap.

### 8 — Policies

`BranchPolicy@viewAny` → key `organisation.branches.view.any`
`BranchPolicy@create` → `organisation.branches.create.any`
`BranchPolicy@update` → `organisation.branches.update.any`
`BranchPolicy@delete` → `organisation.branches.deactivate.any`
Same shape for Department, Team, User placement (`organisation.users.place.any`).

Because BE-03 is not built yet, each Policy method **must call** `$user->hasPermission($key)` and this story adds a temporary `HasPermission` trait on `User` that returns `true` for a hard-coded `admin@example.com` and `false` otherwise. ### 9 — Audit logger

**File: `app/Domains/Security/Services/AuditLogger.php`**

```php
public function record(?Authenticatable $actor, string $action, Model $target, ?array $before, ?array $after): AuditLog
{
    return AuditLog::create([
        'actor_uuid'  => $actor?->uuid,
        'action'      => $action,
        'target_type' => class_basename($target),
        'target_id'   => (string) $target->getKey(),
        'before'      => $before,
        'after'       => $after,
        'recorded_at' => now(),
    ]);
}
```

No `update`/`delete` methods exposed; `AuditLog` model has protected `$guarded = []` plus explicit `deleted_at` absence — table is append-only.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Empty or missing locale in `name`** → FormRequest `array:ar,en` + `required|string` on each key fails with 422; both languages are mandatory (see rules at Task 6).
- **Unicode / RTL text in Arabic `name`** → JSON column stores UTF-8; verify collation `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` on production MySQL. Tests must include an Arabic string with combining marks.
- **Duplicate `code` within scope** → DB unique index (`branches.code`, `departments(branch_id, code)`, `teams(department_id, code)`) surfaces as `Illuminate\Database\QueryException`; map to 422 `code.duplicate` in the FormRequest via `unique:...` pre-check.
- **Deactivating a department with open tickets** → `DepartmentUsageChecker` returns `> 0`; Action throws `DepartmentInUseException`; handler returns `409 department.has_open_tickets` with `meta.open_tickets` count. Enforced in `Actions/DeactivateDepartment.php`.
- **Deactivating a branch that has active departments** → Add symmetric check via `BranchUsageChecker` (concrete implementation counts active `departments`), return `409 branch.has_active_departments`. Enforced in `Actions/DeactivateBranch.php`.
- **Two concurrent `SetPrimaryBranchForUser` calls** → Wrap in `DB::transaction` + `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on pivot rows for the user (`lockForUpdate()` on the pivot query builder). Otherwise both requests can leave `is_primary = true` on two rows.
- **User with zero branches asked to set primary** → 422 `user.branch_not_attached`.
- **Detaching a user's only branch that is currently primary** → 409 `user.primary_branch_required`; force `SetPrimaryBranchForUser` on another branch first.
- **Deleting `users` row with pivot rows** → `cascadeOnDelete` on `user_branch` and `user_department`; audit entry for the delete is not written here (out of scope; users are not deletable via this story).
- **Sanctum `personal_access_tokens.tokenable_id`** still keys off the bigint `users.id`; do **not** drop `id`. Document in the migration docblock.
- **Missing `uuid` on legacy users during migration** → backfill inside the `up()` migration in the same transaction; abort migration if any row remains null.
- **SQLite in tests** does not support partial unique indexes → enforce primary-branch uniqueness in the Action layer, treat DB index as a defence-in-depth for MySQL only. Guard the index creation with `if (DB::getDriverName() !== 'sqlite')`.

## Migration / Rollback

- All new migrations are additive (new tables + one new nullable-then-backfilled column on `users`). `php artisan migrate:rollback` will drop the new tables in reverse order; the `uuid` column on `users` is dropped by its own migration's `down()`.
- **Half-applied state**: if `add_uuid_to_users` succeeds but a later migration fails, the app remains functional (existing auth uses bigint `id`); rerun `migrate` after fixing the failing migration.
- **Data on rollback**: rolling back `audit_logs` drops the audit trail — acceptable in dev/staging only. Document in the migration docblock: production rollbacks require a manual dump of `audit_logs` first.
- **Rename `code` uniqueness**: if a duplicate slipped in via manual seed, drop the unique index, dedupe, re-add. Provide a `RollbackHint` note in the deactivate department test to catch drift.

## Done Criteria

- [ ] Branch, Department, Team can be created, renamed, activated and deactivated through the API (Task 5 routes, Task 4 actions).
- [ ] A Department belongs to exactly one Branch; a Team belongs to exactly one Department (Task 2 migrations `restrictOnDelete` + non-null FKs; Task 6 FormRequest validation).
- [ ] A user can be assigned to one or more departments and one or more branches, with exactly one primary branch (Task 2 pivot tables + Task 4 `SetPrimaryBranchForUser`).
- [ ] Deactivating a Department is blocked (or accepts `reassign_to_department_id`) while open tickets still reference it (Task 4 `DeactivateDepartment` + `DepartmentUsageChecker` contract).
- [ ] Every structure name is stored as `{ ar, en }` in a JSON column and returned as an object (Task 2 `json('name')` + Task 3 `casts` + Task 7 Resource).
- [ ] Every write produces an `audit_logs` row with actor, `before`, `after` (Task 9 `AuditLogger`, called from every Action in Task 4).
- [ ] `make lint && make test` are green inside the container (`CLAUDE.md:22-26`).
- [ ] No `tenant_id`, no cross-organisation columns introduced (`conventions-digest.md:4`).
- [ ] All PKs on new tables are UUID (`conventions-digest.md:5`).
